pairs.difference: A: the motel sign stack is a bright island inside a near-black sky and a dark building. The black sky fills the whole top band, and the lit windows on the left add a second hard light spot. Hero-minus-background gap is 0.284, well past the real maximum of 0.155. B: the whole card is also low key, but the orange-lit brick, mid-grey ring and dark sign face sit closer together (gap 0.081). Both are darker than any real card.
pairs.fix: Raise the whole card to a daytime or twilight key with a light sky. Keep the sign only slightly brighter than its surroundings. Remove the large black sky area.

pairs.difference: A: the fedora crown and brim form one near-black mass against a pale cyan ray background. Only the cream band breaks it. Gap is -0.425 and RMS contrast is 0.223, both outside the real range. B: the cream jacket is a light-to-middle mass on mid-dark green rays, with a dark sash and moderate local contrast. Its numbers sit inside the real band apart from slightly dark corners.
pairs.fix: Draw the hat in a medium warm brown with lighter felt on the top of the crown and the upper brim. Keep the darkest brown only under the brim and in the crease.

pairs.difference: A: the marble lion and plinth are nearly clipped white, with flat white faces on the pedestal. They sit against dark green grass and a dark tree in the top-left corner. Hero is much lighter than background (gap 0.211, above the real range). B: the caravan is light cream on mid purple and mid green, with the same gentle hero lift as the real anchor caravan (gap 0.064).
pairs.fix: Tone the statue down to warm off-white with soft grey shading on its sides and under the mane. Make the lawn and trees lighter and sunnier so the statue is only a step brighter than the grass.

pairs.difference: A: the card is low key (mean 0.491, below the real 0.550). A large dark-brown wood tabletop fills the bottom third, and dark purple stripes fill the top, so the mid-orange radio sits between two dark bands. This matches the dark wooden desks in the computer lessons. B: the light floorboards, mid-blue stripes and light chair give a bright key with even grouping.
pairs.fix: Put the radio on a light honey-wood shelf or a plain light floor. Lighten the purple stripes to a mid lilac. Keep the deepest darks only inside the speaker grille slots.

pairs.difference: B: a near-black camera body sits on a dark wood tabletop that fills the lower half. RMS contrast is 0.217, above the real range, and black takes up a large area. The bright flash reflector is the only white accent. A: the popcorn cart is a mid-value red mass on a mid-blue wall over a pale tiled floor, with light, open groups.
pairs.fix: Draw the camera in a lighter charcoal-blue with silver highlights along its edges. Place it on a light warm floor or a plain orange background instead of dark polished wood.

pairs.difference: A: a dark-brown briefcase on a mid-dark purple studio backdrop. Mean is 0.519, below the real 0.591, and hero and background are both in the dark-middle range, so the card reads low key. B: the bright blue machine has a light glass panel against a lighter magenta wall, and the key is within the real range.
pairs.fix: Use a lighter tan leather for the briefcase. Brighten the purple background into a light violet glow behind the case so the whole card reads bright.

pairs.difference: B: the yellow taxi is the lightest shape, but a large dark-grey road fills the lower half under a dusky purple sky. The light group is small and the dark group is large, like the dark desk floors in the lessons. A: the red bus is a dark mass against bright white clouds and a light sky. Its groups are clear, and the hero is darker than the background, as in the real camera card.
pairs.fix: Set the taxi on a sunny light-grey street under a bright daytime sky. Reduce the dark asphalt to a thin band under the car.

pairs.difference: B: the ring box rim goes to hard near-black next to a clipped white cushion and medal. That is very strong local contrast inside the hero, and the corners darken (vignette 0.162). A: the gold shield is a soft mid value with gentle shading, sitting close to the ray values. Its corners also darken, so this choice is weak.
pairs.fix: Draw the box in a brighter crimson with soft pink highlights on the lid. Shade the cushion cream rather than white. Remove the black shadow band along the base.

pairs.difference: A: dark ivy leaves fill the top and both sides, breaking the card into many small light and dark speckles with no large light group. The blue door is a dark-middle field, the overall key is low (0.552), and the corners darken. B: the dark door is clearly framed by light-middle brick and a white step. Gap is -0.2, slightly beyond the real range, but the light, middle and dark groups are clean.
pairs.fix: Brighten the door to a light sky blue. Thin the ivy to a few leaves at the top corners on a light wall, so the large shapes read as light wall, mid door and a bright wreath.

pairs.difference: A: a white fingerprint card with black ridges on near-black wood. Mean is 0.488, RMS contrast 0.261 and gap 0.365, all far outside the real range. This is chiaroscuro: one bright slab on a dark table. B: the map and magnifier on mid-light wood have a bright, even key, and every measure falls inside the real range.
pairs.fix: Lay the card on a light warm wooden table with soft shadows. Shade the card cream instead of pure white, and draw the fingerprint in mid brown instead of black.

pairs.difference: A: the silver magnifier rim and lens are almost the same mid-grey as the green rings. RMS contrast is 0.073, below the real range, the hero is barely separated by value, and only the red handle goes dark. B: the white backboard glows against mid cyan, with a soft halo behind it and clear separation.
pairs.fix: Brighten the lens with a light highlight and darken the background rings toward the corners. The magnifier should stand out clearly lighter than the green behind it.

pairs.difference: B: the fruit plate is broken into many small dark accents (melon seeds, berries, strawberry shadows) scattered over a light wood table, with no single dark group and a busy middle zone. A: the popsicle is one darker middle mass with crisp light rims on light-middle green rays. Its contrast is low (0.084), but it keeps a simple grouping.
pairs.fix: Show fewer, larger fruit pieces on a plain light background with rays. Keep the darks to one shadow under the plate instead of many scattered seeds and berries.

pattern: Generated cards break from the real key in two ways. First, they push it low: dark wooden tables or floors, night or dusk skies and dark studio backdrops take up large areas, so the mean falls below about 0.55. Second, they over-separate a bright hero from a dark setting (gap above about 0.16), with clipped white faces and hard black next to white inside the hero. Real cards stay mid-to-high key, with light, simple backgrounds and only a modest value step between hero and background.
